import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('hrsa_organ_donation_transplantation.xlsx', sheet_name='Overview - National')
df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
df['Living'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Number of living organ donors recovered'], errors='coerce')
sub = df[(df['Organ'] == 'All') & (df['Year'] >= 2021) & (df['Year'] <= 2025)]
best_row = sub.loc[sub['Living'].idxmax()]
result = str(int(best_row['Year']))

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('hrsa_organ_donation_transplantation.xlsx', sheet_name='Donor Demographics')
sub = df[(df['Category'].astype(str).str.contains('Insurance')) & 
         (df['Donor Type Filter'] == 'Living Donor') & 
         (df['Level'] == 'Uninsured')]
result = int(sub['Donor Count'].iloc[0])

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('hrsa_organ_donation_transplantation.xlsx', sheet_name='Waitlist-Candidate Registration')
sub = df[(df['Candidate/Registration'] == 'Candidates') & 
         (df['Year of Addition'] == 2025) & 
         (df['Organ Type'] == 'All')]
male = int(sub['Sex: Male'].iloc[0])
female = int(sub['Sex: Female'].iloc[0])
result = male - female

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('hrsa_organ_donation_transplantation.xlsx', sheet_name='Recipient Demographics')
sub = df[(df['Transplant Year'] == 2023) & 
         (df['Donor Type'] == 'Deceased Donor') & 
         (~df['Organ Transplanted'].isin(['All Transplanted Organ Types', 'Kidney-Pancreas']))]
sub = sub.sort_values(by='Total Distinct Recipients', ascending=False)
result = sub['Organ Transplanted'].head(3).tolist()

import pandas as pd

sub = df[(df['Category'].astype(str).str.contains('Sex')) & (df['Donor Type Filter'] == 'Living Donor')]
counts = dict(zip(sub['Level'], sub['Donor Count'].astype(int)))
result = 'yes' if counts['Female'] > counts['Male'] else 'no'
